turns.speaker: narr
turns.text: Imagine if every white lie lit you up like the sun.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.text: Leo... did you eat all my warm cookies?

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: What? No! I wasn't even near the kitchen.

turns.speaker: narr
turns.text: Small fib, soft lantern. Big lie? Whole street sees it.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Okay, maybe one tiny bite! Totally not five!

turns.speaker: mom
turns.text: Leo, you're brighter than the streetlight outside.
